Definition: from G3956 and G2041; all-working, i.e. adroit (shrewd):--crafty.
BiblicalUsage: Panourgos occurs once: Paul says, be it so, I did not burden you; nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you with guile — quoting back the charge his critics made against him.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Paul answers the charge by owning the words and turning them: his craft was the gospel's persuasion, not a trick for gain.
